content: Hudani Ho Kuruku Igha
Bi sonosuse dajiense fugie shenqi khizhezhi dolon qienxiende kieliezho, "Ta echidene Hudai hokuku dolon ighai zeminde pojie."
Ji 1 gie qienxien echidene ighani zeminde pojiese yewoni zhanzi taisan, yewoni nigiedai beiisanlai beye jiere zannan, du yara khizhezho.
Ji 2 gie qienxien ighani haide pojiese hai fugusan kunni chusun mutun gholuwo. Haini amitu ojienla man fuguwo.
Ji 3 gie qienxien ighani moron, bulade pojiese usu chusun gholuwo.
Bi sonosuse usuni gonjisan qienxien kieliezho,

content.text: Hhela shentu, xienzhilai chusunyi usurughazhi daozho.

content: Bi pse sonosuse sidagha gieku teizise shenqi bizhi kieliezho,

content.text: chii panjiku zhen wo, gundan wo!"

content: Ji 4 gie qienxien ighani naran nudunde pojiese nanran kunni khanghala kouine.
Kunlai hende hhereide kouise nenli bizhi zeinanni gonjisan Hudai nierei sugiezhi, da geizhen ulie giezhi kuaikui Hudade ulie ogine.
Ji 5 gie qienxien ighani yewoni zowide pojiese yewoni gojia kharalawo. Kunla tendun shouizhi shidunne zhouzho.
Tendun shouiku, yara khizheku yenyinghala hhela asiman jieredu Hudai sugiezhi da giesansene geizhen ulie giene.
Ji 6 gie qienxien ighani Yufalaji fugie moronde pojiese moron ghozhi dunbangiese iresan honshanlade mo zhunbei giezho.
Bi pse chanlase baghai xianlitu ghuran zannan ruhher lun, yewo, jia xienzhilai amanse khizhezho.
Hhelashi sheitanni ruhher wo, ghudureqi gie shidane, duyani honshanlai hhende echizhi hhelai Fugie Nenlitu Hudai famatu udude hhantulaghazhi eghindughane giezho.
Uzhe, bi ghughei mutun irene. Jinxin giezhi jienne musisan kunde fuqi wine. Hulan muchughun ulie yozhi shizhekune ulie uzheghane.
Hhe zannan ruhherla honshanlai nie oronde hhantulaghazho, ene oronni Xibolai kielienghala Hamagiedun giene.
Ji 7 gie qienxien ighani asimande pojiese fugie shenqi dajiendedu baozo jierese khizhezhi kieliezho, "Chenjiwo!"
Ingiese shanjien, shenqi, olien tunguliesan, fugiede zemin gojioluku wine. Imutu fugie yenzhunde zemin gojioluku kun zemin jiere bisanse uwo.
Hhe fugie chenshi ghaluzhi ghuran gholuzhi go gojialani chenshilaye man furawo. Huda Babilun fugie chenshini sumula iredene goya hokukune hhei jiere bouzheghawo.
Go haini daola piizhi ulalaiye chanla dane.
Pse fugie mendoula asimanse kunyi jiere bouzhezhi niekozi gundude 70 jin wo. Ene mendouni zeinan hende fugieshi kunla Hudai sugiezho.
